label: Rút gọn tối đa (Max Concise - Shorts/Reels)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese extremely concise, tight, and fast to read in 1-2 seconds on mobile screens. Cut all unnecessary filler words while preserving key meaning and correct address forms.

label: Kể chuyện / Review phim (Storytelling Recap)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese sound like an engaging film recap / storyteller voice: smooth flow, emotionally vivid, natural narrative transitions, maintaining character tension.

label: Kịch tính / Giật gân (Dramatic & Punchy)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese punchy, tense, and dramatic with sharp contrasts and high-impact phrasing, perfect for dramatic conflict scenes, cliffhangers, and short dramas.

label: Khẩu ngữ đời thường (Casual & Trendy)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese sound modern, conversational, natural, and trendy like a creator on TikTok or social media, avoiding textbook, stiff, or overly literary phrasing.

label: Lồng tiếng nhịp nhàng (Smooth Dubbing Flow)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese flow smoothly, rhythmic, and natural to pronounce for voice dubbing and TTS, avoiding tongue-twisters, awkward syllable clusters, or unnatural breath breaks.

label: Thuyết phục / Bán hàng (Sales & Commercial)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese persuasive, benefit-driven, smooth, and compelling for product showcases, marketing videos, or sales pitches without exaggerating source facts.

label: Phụ đề chuẩn mực (Natural Subtitles)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese natural, balanced, culturally adapted, and very pleasant to read as standard on-screen video subtitles.

label: Trang trọng / Chuyên nghiệp (Formal & Professional)
instruction: Make the Vietnamese polished, formal, authoritative, and grammatically precise, suitable for business presentations, documentaries, and professional interviews.
